title: hub_question
description: The person's whole question to a hub agent, the items that say it is solved, and the list of assignments the hub split it into, which the person agreed to once (the person, 2026-11-20, 'Ask once per question (Recommended)' and 'until solve the problem'; meta_agent/tasks/033). Written by the hub in its question/. No numbers: a value the question gives is a card of its own. The person's later words are appended under person_words in a new revision (v<N>_<name>), the rest unchanged; check 25 judges it.

numbers.description: none: what is asked is in words, and every value stays in a card a member wrote

what.description: what must be answered, in words; answered only by a result card that is not held

done_when.description: the question is solved when every item is answered by a result that is not held (the seat's reading of 'until solve the problem')

assignments.description: the ids of the assignments the person agreed to; an assignment outside this list is a new list, shown to the person again

words.description: the person's words agreeing to this list, verbatim

agreed.description: the person's agreement to the list, once for the question; absent until given, and nothing is carried on the hub's trigger before it

words.description: the person's words, verbatim, numbers included

person_words.description: the person's words given after the agreement, appended in a new revision that keeps the question, its items, its list and the agreement unchanged; a later round's assignment within the list quotes from them (the person, 2026-11-21, 'Append to the question (Recommended)'; hub-3)
